title: The 4 Best Travel Neck Pillows for Side Sleepers
h1: The 4 Best Travel Neck Pillows for Side Sleepers
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for travel neck pillows for side sleepers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel neck pillows for side sleepers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow
products.blurb: Key specs: Dense memory foam horseshoe with tall side walls, Seat strap keeps the pillow anchored against the headrest, Quick-dry cover.
strengths: Tall, dense foam sides resist compression from a head leaning sideways for hours
Strap prevents the pillow from sliding away from the window over time
Holds its loft night after night better than an inflatable design
limitations: Bulkiest packed size in this list
Firm foam feels less soft on first use than a fleece-covered pillow
features: Dense memory foam horseshoe with tall side walls
Seat strap keeps the pillow anchored against the headrest
Compresses for the included carry bag

products.name: J-Pillow Travel Pillow
products.blurb: Key specs: J-shaped foam arm designed to cradle the head against a surface, Non-inflatable fill that holds shape, Works turned toward window or aisle.
strengths: The long foam arm was designed specifically for leaning against a window or seat back
Foam does not compress flat under sustained side weight the way thin inflatables can
Same pillow works whether you favor the left or right side
limitations: Larger and less packable than a scarf-style or inflatable pillow
Some side sleepers find the J-shape's chin arm unnecessary and slightly in the way
features: J-shaped foam arm designed to cradle the head against a surface
Works turned toward window or aisle

products.name: Trtl Pillow Travel Neck Pillow
products.blurb: Key specs: Internal plinth wraps around one side of the neck, Scarf-style fleece exterior, Weighs about 4.5 ounces.
strengths: The internal plinth can be positioned toward the side you favor for sleeping
Packs far smaller than a foam horseshoe
Soft fleece is comfortable directly against the cheek and window
limitations: Less structured lateral support than dense memory foam under sustained weight
One-size wrap fits a narrower range of body sizes
features: Internal plinth wraps around one side of the neck

products.name: MLVOC Inflatable Travel Pillow
products.blurb: Key specs: Inflatable U-shape, adjustable firmness, Micro-velvet cover, Deflates flat for packing.
strengths: Inflating it fully gives more lateral firmness than the default setting
Deflates to pocket size when not in use
limitations: Can slowly lose firmness over a long flight, requiring a top-up
Least structured lateral support of the four for sustained side sleeping

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
